limitations: Current-panel and all-model frontiers use point estimates, not tests of superiority.
Costs characterize selected responses, not exact prospective deployed-policy costs.
Historical and current model observations were collected on different dates.
Opus uses a 16,000-token cap with a 64,000-token allowance.
Historical usage fields remain null when not reported. Unknown charges are retained in the internal collection audit.
